text:
alex: heads up, new hire hit a blocker during the redwoodctl quickstart on Linux. brew install equivalent gave binary, then `redwoodctl init` created profile but login fails.

pei: what error?

alex: CLI prints: `login failed: dial tcp 127.0.0.1:12345: connect: connection refused` after browser-based auth. The local callback server never receives the request.

owen: Are you using WSL or docker? network namespaces often cause this.

alex: it's a Fedora VM. We run the sample app in a docker container that maps host 127.0.0.1:12345 -> container, so from browser the callback reaches container but redwoodctl binds to localhost only.

pei: Hmm. redwoodctl's local server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and rejects external callbacks. We added `--bind-address` in a PR months ago but it isn't documented.

alex: The quickstart uses `--headless` but no hint to set bind. New dev didn't know to pass `--local-callback-host=0.0.0.0`.

owen: We should change default: bind to 0.0.0.0 when `--headless` is used inside Docker/CI detection, or at least print a clearer hint suggesting `--local-callback-host` with examples.

pei: Agreed. Also two other DX things: 1) installer messages don't mention `--profile` so users end up with `default` and conflicts with existing env vars, 2) login retries are too aggressive and obscure the real cause (connection refused).

alex: For retries maybe show the cause and a single friendly line: "Tip: If you're in Docker/VM, run redwoodctl login --headless --local-callback-host 0.0.0.0 --local-callback-port 12345"

owen: Also, auth flow assumes a browser can reach the local callback URL. For headless CI we should encourage the `--device-code` flow as a fallback and document it in quickstart and the installer post-install note.

pei: Good point. Add doctor checks: 1) detect common container environments (docker, podman, WSL) and warn about bind semantics, 2) check if port 12345 is reachable externally and fail early with hints.

ci-bot: deploy-check: doc change branch `devex/redwoodctl-bind-docs` passes lints

alex: I'll open two PRs: docs + CLI changes. Quick fixes: expose `--local-callback-host` in help, slow down retry backoff (1s -> 4s -> 16s), and a clearer postinstall note with `--profile quickstart` and the device-code hint.

owen: can you include a test that simulates docker host binding? we can add an integration that starts a tiny HTTP endpoint in a separate namespace.

alex: will do. tagging devex and eng-platform. Thanks.
